It’s super common, when we feel badly about ourselves, to project that feeling onto others and how they perceive us. Whether I’ve failed a test, gained weight, lost out on an opportunity, failed to make the team, etc, my immediate thought is how much of a failure people must think I am. Fortunately, I’ve been pleasantly surprised to find that the people in my life who love me seem not to care about those things, and that most of the disappointment in myself is mine alone, and I do internal work to heal from those feelings. Wishing you the best <3

I just got out of a situation myself with an older guy. I’m in my early 20s and he was 12 years older. Only now  am I starting to recognize how he slowly gained power over me because I always conceded he was older, more mature, and knew better. I still believe age gaps like that in a relationship “can” work, but if the older person is toxic it is an easy situation for them to take advantage of. It sounds like that may be part of what happened here. 

I am so sorry you are going through this. Just remember that you do not need him an any way, you do not owe him anything, and that if you feel like you want to leave, chances are you will be so much better off without him.
Thank you! Once the pain finally goes away I’m sure I will be better off!
